design.transport: Every registry write goes through setActiveTransport (map write first, then a snapshot of observers, each in try/catch with logger.warn); same-object registration is a no-op; releaseActiveTransport clears the slot only if the object is still active; new subscribeActiveCampaignSyncTransport; the test reset clears observers. No wire, lastSeq, ACK or latch change
design.seat: New campaignSyncTransportSeat.ts: ICampaignSyncSeat {matchId, campaignId, playerId, role}; boundCampaignSyncTransport checks all four; followCampaignSyncSeat subscribes then reconciles, detaches A before attaching B, passes replaced, never attaches/adopts/creates/closes a foreign socket; waitForSeatCampaignSnapshot has one fixed timeout, honours abort, disposes on settle, rejects a foreign event or state campaignId
design.entry: Resolves identity via ?campaignIdentity=1 with the minted bearer only in Authorization and cache:'no-store'; validates non-empty matchId/campaignId and a known status before any socket; 400/401/404 are final with no anonymous fallback (CF-G2A-5); throwIfAborted before the creator, which binds expectedCampaignId; snapshot wait through the seat, active-seat re-check after the await; mirror uses the resolved campaignId; per-attempt AbortController aborted on unmount; the failure path closes only its own A
design.launch: Both creators bound to campaign.id; sends via boundCampaignSyncTransport(seat); the listener follows the seat, re-sends the current choice once to a replacement B and checks matchId/missionId; cleanup detaches without closing the shared socket; seat playerId from the stored co-op token, never the coopIdentity labels
design.surface: expectedCampaignId: campaignId at both connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport calls (CF-H16)

privacy: G2 is the first in-repo consumer of G2A's identity mode and adds no disclosure beyond G2A's recorded PRIV-1 correlation (the guest already receives the campaignId in its first snapshot). The entry panel keeps minting unscoped tokens via /api/multiplayer/auth/token and sends them only in the Authorization header of the identity request, never as a query token. PRIV-1 remains a B15 remote-support obligation (R-PRIV-1); joinableLobbies.ts and token.ts are unchanged controls
